scope: Proposition 5.5 (Marginal variance flow) of the manuscript “Quenched SLE₃ Universality for the Weak Random-Bond Ising Model” (preprints/Quenched-SLE3-Universality-for-the-Weak-Random-Bond-Ising-Model-October-5-2026/quenched-sle3-weak-random-bond-ising.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 218 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 dbf1578546653fc5), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF pages 30-31. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. The quote crosses a page break and includes whatever the extraction places there, such as a page number. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
